name: Summit Pizza Co. Original "Cheese Doodles" (Garlic-Butter Mozzarella Swirls)
brandOrRestaurant: Summit Pizza Co. (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Summit's scratch-made refined white pizza dough rolled with Wisconsin mozzarella and baked until soft and pillowy—zero seeds or raw vegetables.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Take a Lactaid for the mozzarella, ask for light garlic butter, and dip sparingly in warm marinara rather than heavy buttermilk ranch.
